scope: Explicit timezone exceptions to the canonical URL-date candidate check

exceptions.basis: Scheduled 08:50 JST statistical/minutes release falls ten minutes before the exclusive UTC cutoff. A local-day canonical URL does not establish post-cutoff publication.
exceptions.verification_limit: The standard release schedule and date are used; original primary-body intraday snapshots were not independently fetched or archived. This is not a claim of exhaustive original-vintage verification.
